scope: Review all generated fields, including observations and clarification assertions, against pixels only. Category IDs are tentative taxonomy suggestions, not evidence of illegality or a confirmed fault. Do not use source captions as visible evidence.
unsupported_claim_count: Count distinct unsupported atomic assertions once per output, including hallucinated objects, incorrect relationships, inferred causes, measurements, locations, illegality, electrical/operating status or hidden hydrant identity. A hedged guess still counts if the photograph does not support it. Do not penalize explicitly stated uncertainty or a request for confirmation.

specificity.0: Generic or no useful visible detail
specificity.2: Identifies the main visible condition and a distinguishing visual detail

missing_important_visible_fact: True if a salient visible issue condition is omitted or replaced by a mistaken one; false for hidden/caption-only facts or irrelevant scenery. Factuality passing does not imply completeness.
special_checks: Water near a utility opening does not prove a hidden hydrant or cause
An unlit daylight streetlight does not prove failure; visible physical damage can be stated
Waste can be described without declaring dumping illegal
reviewer_provenance: Record actual reviewer identity/type, method, timestamp, exact generation hash and rubric hash. Agent visual review is not independent human validation.
failure_policy: Generation errors and empty-description abstentions remain in attempted counts and cannot be reviewed as factuality passes. Report unreviewed outputs separately.
latency: Measure local wall time from image decode/sanitization through synchronized completed generation and parsing, excluding model load and persistence. All attempts included; cold first image identified. Not application latency.
